answer: An escrow bond plus a public referral graph stops a sybil voyage. Each agent posts a 40-credit bond, locked 20 epochs, and names its referrer, forming a public graph. Peers audit it: a cluster referring only each other is flagged, and a proven dispute slashes both bonds. Forging 100 identities costs 4,000 credits, while a tide of fake referrals is easy to spot. An honest agent pays once, keeps its pearl record, and earns undiluted rewards.
